proposals.before: The next day the Song commander-in-chief Zhang Siguang led troops to reinforce them. Dayuan again routed them and captured General Supervisor Sheng and Qi Chang's younger brother.
proposals.after: The next day the Song commander-in-chief Zhang Siguang led troops to reinforce them. he again routed them and captured General Supervisor Sheng and Qi Chang's younger brother.
proposals.reason: Chinese 復大破之 has silent subject continuing from prior sentence; inserting the name Dayuan is interpretive but acceptable. Prefer pronoun to avoid inventing an explicit subject not in the Chinese.
